diff --git a/src/git/blame.test.ts b/src/git/blame.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 00000000..c2ec27aa
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/git/blame.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,60 @@
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { describe, it } from "vite-plus/test";
+import { parseBlamePorcelain } from "./blame.ts";
+
+const A = "a".repeat(40);
+const B = "b".repeat(40);
+
+describe("parseBlamePorcelain", () => {
+  it("reads the sha, author, time and summary of each line", () => {
+    const porcelain = [
+      `${A} 1 1 2`,
+      "author Ada",
+      "author-mail <ada@example.com>",
+      "author-time 1700000000",
+      "summary Add the first lines",
+      "filename a.ts",
+      "\tone",
+      `${A} 2 2`,
+      "author Ada",
+      "author-time 1700000000",
+      "summary Add the first lines",
+      "filename a.ts",
+      "\ttwo",
+      `${B} 1 3 1`,
+      "author Ben",
+      "author-time 1700000100",
+      "summary summary of a fix",
+      "previous 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 a.ts",
+      "filename a.ts",
+      "\tsummary three",
+      "",
+    ].join("\n");
+    assert.deepEqual(parseBlamePorcelain(porcelain), [
+      {
+        sha: A,
+        author: "Ada",
+        timestamp: 1700000000,
+        summary: "Add the first lines",
+        line: 1,
+        text: "one",
+      },
+      {
+        sha: A,
+        author: "Ada",
+        timestamp: 1700000000,
+        summary: "Add the first lines",
+        line: 2,
+        text: "two",
+      },
+      {
+        sha: B,
+        author: "Ben",
+        timestamp: 1700000100,
+        summary: "summary of a fix",
+        line: 3,
+        text: "summary three",
+      },
+    ]);
+  });
+});
